source_lineage: redundant residue number systems as an error-control analogy

circuit_a.name: STATISTICAL_VOTE_CIRCUIT
circuit_a.question_shape: many workers answer the same semantic question
circuit_a.strength: tolerates a minority of independent weak errors
circuit_a.failure: correlated error can create a confident wrong consensus

circuit_b.name: EXACT_COORDINATE_CIRCUIT
circuit_b.question_shape: workers/channels return different coordinates of one latent object
circuit_b.strength: exact recovery inside the representation's uniqueness domain
circuit_b.failure: one corrupted coordinate can corrupt plain reconstruction

circuit_c.name: REDUNDANT_EXACT_COORDINATE_CIRCUIT
circuit_c.strength: can detect/correct bounded coordinate errors in a sufficiently redundant code
circuit_c.failure: requires a valid algebraic/typed decomposition and enough redundancy

catfood_hypothesis: For semantic review, use vote circuits where no exact decomposition exists. For structured state/evidence with exact orthogonal coordinates, prefer deterministic reconstruction. Hybrid systems can use local vote/review inside each coordinate and deterministic reconstruction across coordinates.
claim_ceiling: Toy information-combination study only. Semantic software-review facts do not automatically form a CRT/RRNS code.
